I know that most of you ( and me too a while back) live hand to mouth. But here is a dirty little secret that may help out. There (from time to time ) comes up pieces of land way out in very Rural America) that come up for sale. The land is mostly worthless as there is no water, no power, no telephone service and often little in the way of roads to get there. (HENCE THE STATEMENT "YOU CAN'T GET THERE FROM HERE") This land goes for around $500 to an acre with smallest parcell size of 5 acres. Any way once you get the property you are going to need to drill a well. That is going to be your major expense. Once the well is in you will probably going to want to get a Aermotor windmill to dive a lift pump. The lift pump is a piston with a valve in the bottom of it. When the piston goes down the valve opens to allow water to enter the cylinder. When the piston is pulled up the valve at the bottom closes and the valve at the top of the cylinder opens allowing water to flow through and up the well pipe. These pump don't provide a large flow rate but they don't require any power other than wind. What you need to do after the well is drilled is build an underground cistern for water storage. Of course since you wont be on the land 24/7/365 you are going to need to vandal proof it. I found that a cave with a good strong steel concrete door hidden behind a rock fall is just the thing. You can store the wind mill and tower in the cave and bring it out when you need it. Of course once you cut the cord with Civilization (or things go to hell) you can live in the cave while you build a house. However caves have some good points.
